domains.name: Algebra
domains.description: Linear equations, linear functions, systems and inequalities: writing a straight-line relationship from a context and solving or interpreting it.

skills.name: Linear equations in one variable
skills.description: Solving one-variable linear equations, including ones with fractions or variables on both sides, and deciding when there is no solution or infinitely many.

skills.name: Linear functions
skills.description: Writing and reading linear functions from a table, graph or story, and interpreting slope and intercept as rates and starting values.

skills.name: Linear equations in two variables
skills.description: Building a two-variable linear equation from a context, finding intercepts and slope, and switching between standard and slope-intercept form.

skills.name: Systems of linear equations
skills.description: Solving two linear equations in two variables by substitution or elimination, and reasoning about systems with no solution or infinitely many.

skills.name: Linear inequalities
skills.description: Writing, solving and graphing linear inequalities in one or two variables, including constraints from budgets, capacities and minimums.

domains.name: Advanced Math
domains.description: Quadratic, exponential, polynomial, radical and rational relationships: rewriting expressions, solving nonlinear equations and reading nonlinear functions.

skills.name: Equivalent expressions
skills.description: Rewriting polynomial, rational and exponential expressions in equivalent forms by expanding, factoring, combining terms or using exponent rules.

skills.name: Quadratic equations
skills.description: Solving quadratics by factoring, completing the square or the quadratic formula, and using the discriminant to count real solutions.

skills.name: Quadratic functions and parabolas
skills.description: Reading vertex, intercepts, axis of symmetry and maximum or minimum values from a quadratic in standard, vertex or factored form.

skills.name: Exponential functions
skills.description: Modeling growth and decay with exponential functions, interpreting the base as a percent change, and comparing exponential with linear change.

skills.name: Polynomial and rational functions
skills.description: Connecting zeros, factors and graphs of polynomials, and handling rational expressions and equations, including extraneous solutions.

skills.name: Radical and absolute value equations
skills.description: Solving equations with square roots or absolute values, and checking each candidate against the original equation.

skills.name: Nonlinear systems
skills.description: Solving a system made of a line and a parabola or other nonlinear curve, algebraically or by reading intersection points.

skills.name: Function notation and transformations
skills.description: Evaluating and composing functions written in function notation, and describing how shifts and stretches change a graph or a formula.

domains.name: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis
domains.description: Ratios, rates, percentages, units, data displays, statistics and probability: quantitative reasoning about real situations and real data.

skills.name: Ratios, rates and proportions
skills.description: Setting up and solving proportions, unit rates and scale problems, including rates that combine or compare.

skills.name: Unit conversion
skills.description: Converting between units, including squared and cubed units and rates such as miles per hour to feet per second.

skills.name: Percentages
skills.description: Percent of a quantity, percent increase and decrease, successive percent changes and finding an original amount from a changed one.

skills.name: One-variable data
skills.description: Reading histograms, dot plots and box plots, and reasoning about mean, median, range and standard deviation, including the effect of an outlier.

skills.name: Two-variable data and models
skills.description: Interpreting scatterplots, lines and curves of best fit, and using a model to predict or to explain what a slope means.

skills.name: Probability and conditional probability
skills.description: Finding probabilities from counts or two-way tables, including conditional probability given a row or column.

skills.name: Inference and study design
skills.description: Using sample statistics and margins of error to make careful claims about a population, and judging what an experiment or observational study can show.

domains.name: Geometry and Trigonometry
domains.description: Area, volume, lines, angles, triangles, right-triangle trigonometry and circles, often with a coordinate or real-world setting.

skills.name: Area and volume
skills.description: Finding perimeter, area, surface area and volume of common figures and solids, and how they scale when lengths change.

skills.name: Lines, angles and triangles
skills.description: Using vertical, supplementary and parallel-line angle facts and triangle angle sums to find unknown angles.

skills.name: Similar and congruent triangles
skills.description: Using similarity ratios and congruence criteria to find missing sides and to compare areas of similar figures.

skills.name: Right triangles and the Pythagorean theorem
skills.description: Applying the Pythagorean theorem and the special 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles to find lengths.

skills.name: Right-triangle trigonometry
skills.description: Using sine, cosine and tangent in right triangles, the relationship between sine and cosine of complementary angles, and radian measure.

skills.name: Circles
skills.description: Arc length, sector area, inscribed and central angles, and the equation of a circle in the coordinate plane, including completing the square.
